structured_output.summary: The change implements %TypedArray%.prototype.every in the order the spec gives. It validates the typed array (ValidateTypedArray with `?`), computes TypedArrayLength once before the callable check, throws a TypeError for a non-callable callback, then loops over k < length. Each iteration gets the element via TypedArrayGetElement, calls the callback with `?` propagation, applies ToBoolean, returns false early, and finally returns true. Every step is kept as a comment above its code. No special-casing, no made-up values, no swallowed errors. The gate's not-implemented failures come from BigInt and Array.prototype.unshift in other files, not from this one.
